description: Is this address sanctioned? Screens a crypto address against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list's published digital currency addresses (ETH, USDC, USDT, XBT, SOL, TRX and others): the listed entity, programs and listing date on a match, or not found as of the list date. Adds whether it is a wallet (EOA) or contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, or a wallet or program-derived address on Solana. Not legal advice. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Address to screen: 0x (EVM), base58 (Solana), or any other currency's address with chain=other

chain.description: Chain for the wallet/contract check; defaults to base for 0x addresses, solana for Solana addresses, otherwise other (list check only)

name: address_sanctions_screen
